notes: Lots of great peach flavor in a cool blue can, one of Alani's best core flavors
body:
One of Alani's best, and although I didn't count it towards the score, what a great can design. This one best works best very chilled. It's also slightly thicker than the rest of the Alani flavors (similar to the limited edition witches brew).

Out of all the core brands, I'll have to crown this in terms of peach flavors. It's very sweet and no amount tart if that's what you're into.

This one is good regardless of the season, and drinking it reminds me of a slushie in the summer. It's one that I'll keep coming back to, especially since I can just drink one, get great energy, and not have the dehydration headache right after.

Great intro alani drink.
name: Juicy Peach
